data.summary: Business Analyst with 8.5 years of experience delivering business transformation and process improvement initiatives across Capital Markets, Investment Banking, Fund Accounting and Financial Reporting within global banking environments. Strong expertise in requirements elicitation, stakeholder management, business process analysis, AS-IS / TO-BE process mapping, gap and impact analysis, BRD/FRD development, user stories and UAT across Agile Scrum and Waterfall environments. Experienced in partnering with business, operations, finance and technology stakeholders to define future-state processes, identify process gaps and support operating-model and transformation initiatives. Strong domain expertise in Fund Accounting, NAV processing, trade lifecycle, security pricing, corporate actions, reconciliations and financial reporting. Led automation and reporting transformation initiatives to reduce manual effort, strengthen controls and improve operational efficiency.

Performed fund accounting activities including trade processing, corporate actions, subscriptions, redemptions, fee accruals, and cash and stock reconciliations to support accurate and timely NAV calculation.
